claims.claim: Committed changes are confined to scope.modify; proof and admission state remains operational and outside canonical TASK/RUN artifacts.
H4C0 emits a bounded opaque authoring proof tied to its exact-page bootstrap route, generation and submission attempt, without exposing raw chat identity or endpoint.

Production origin revision-1 authoring requires self-hosted proof admission against local H4C0 state. Hosted ingress authenticates the signed admission, and AUTHOR_TASK matches it to the final TASK selector before mutation.

Admission binds the carrier attempt, TASK id, expected main, route, generation and envelope digest. Missing, expired, mismatched, ambiguous and cross-attempt proofs fail closed; valid same-attempt admission replay is idempotent.
Ordinary revisions preserve existing affinity and reject current-chat proofs; explicit legacy routing remains separate.
RUN propagation and local wake implementation remain unchanged, while the ingress workflow retains existing attention, receipt, dispatch and wake-source handling.

Focused regression definitions cover A-to-A, B-to-B, crossed proofs and selectors, missing/stale/wrong-generation proofs, attempt replay, revision preservation, legacy separation and pre-mutation failures.
TASK-308 and TASK-303 lineage artifacts remain unchanged. Documentation preserves Runtime verification, Reviewer verdict, Publisher publication and later disposition authority.
